text:
faiz: Heads up: SI partner 'OnPremia' deployed their integrator in air-gapped customer sites. They just surfaced ~4k events where entitlement_id is missing but device_fingerprint and firmware_build are present. Marketplace accepted events but entitlements didn't attach. Partner requests automated backfill webhook contract and a safe idempotent strategy.
zoe: key constraints: we can't call partner endpoints from air-gapped sites. Partner will ship periodic backfill bundles (signed tar.gz) to an SFTP endpoint we provide. We need a process to ingest those bundles and map events to entitlements without double-charging.	
noah: Billing: ledgers show an undercount of ~56k token-units across 120 customers for 2025-11-02. We need a recon approach + customer messaging template.
tess: Ops mitigation: treat events without entitlement_id as 'pending_enrich' and do NOT write final ledger rows until backfill verification. That avoids immediate customer-facing charges. We can create provisional placeholders in the audit log only.
faiz: partner is asking for two things: (1) a webhook-style callback for each resolved event once we map entitlement, and (2) a signed manifest format we can verify. They want near-real-time notifications after we process their SFTP bundles.
zoe: proposal for ingestion worker: 1) accept signed bundle, verify signature, 2) extract mapping rows: [event_fingerprint -> entitlement_id], 3) for each mapping: check if ledger has pending_enrich entry, if yes apply idempotent settle (compare audit_nonce), 4) emit webhook to partner with resolution result. We'll store a short-lived idempotency key 'bundle_id:event_fingerprint' to avoid re-processing duplicates.
noah: finance policy: because we held charges, we can choose to either post charges immediately after mapping or include them in the next daily settle. Suggest: post to ledger only after verification; send a customer-facing 'pending charge' email if summed tokens > threshold (e.g., $50). Also include clear note on off-cycle credits if partner backfill changes mapping after posting.
tess: runbook notes: ledger write guard required during bundle application: `ledger.acquire_lease('onpremia-backfill', ttl=900)`. Also add metric alerts: `onpremia.backfill.processed`, `onpremia.backfill.duplicates`, `onpremia.backfill.signature_failures`. Page SRE if signature_failures > 5 in 1h.
zoe: webhook contract sample (partner-facing):
```
POST /partners/onpremia/webhooks/backfill-result
Headers: X-OnPremia-Bundle: bf-20251103-01, X-Signature: sha256=...
Body:
{
  "event_fingerprint": "sha256:abc123",
  "resolved_entitlement": "op-sku-edge-100",
  "tokens": 420,
  "resolution": "applied",
  "applied_at": "2025-11-03T04:12:00Z",
  "audit_nonce": "nonce-9876"
}
```
zoe: internal idempotency rule: only apply mapping if stored audit_nonce != incoming.audit_nonce. If audit_nonce missing, require idempotency via bundle_id and fingerprint uniqueness.
faiz: partner also wants a SQL query to show suspect customers so they can prioritize which sites to push backfills for.
zoe: SQL (7-day window):
```
SELECT partner_id, customer_id, count(*) AS pending_events, sum(tokens) AS pending_tokens
FROM partner_usage_events
WHERE entitlement_id IS NULL AND event_fingerprint IS NOT NULL
  AND received_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY partner_id, customer_id
ORDER BY pending_tokens DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
noah: perfect. I'll use that to prepare customer impact report and draft the comms. Template should include: what happened, what we held, expected next steps, and how off-cycle adjustments are handled.
tess: monitoring tile request for partner seats: show pending_events_last_24h, processed_backfills_last_24h, signature_failure_rate. Keep it lightweight.
faiz: action items: zoe -> implement bundle ingestion worker + idempotency keys + webhook sender (ETA 72h to staging); tess -> add ledger lease + alerts + runbook (ETA 24h); noah -> draft finance policy & customer note (ETA 12h); faiz -> share SFTP details and contract template with OnPremia.

faiz: thanks team — we'll meet after the staging run to validate sample bundles and webhook receipts.
